x: A little further back came Tobin in 12th position, followed by Lucas 19th, Morrell 22nd, and Murdoch 36th. Our next man was round about the 50 mark.
Further victories were notched up by Murdoch (100), Cocks (880) Kerr (1 ml.) and Derek Wade who jumped a splendid 22'6½" in his speciality event.

A sub-59 first lap by Birchfield's Murdoch was followed by Spen pushing the pace along to 1:59 at 800m and 3:00 at 1200. Spen was still ahead with a mere 30 metres left and with Steve Sharp in close attendance, but the Sale man lunged at the line and got the verdict.
